name: Secret Triaina
desc: A spear with a tip fashioned from a jewel. Its simple construction is geared towards beginners. Should the spearhead break, it can be replaced without having to modify any other part.

eff.name: Vulnerability Exposure
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 1]% chance to extend the duration of stun effects by 5 second(s) when attacking a stunned enemy.

eff.name: Spreading Scars
eff.desc1: Reduces skill cooldowns when you stun an enemy.

eff.name: Triple Thrust
eff.desc1: Restores HP by [Lv. x 1]% on a critical hit.
